technical_complexity.rationale: Applying language models to case documents with per matter isolated infrastructure is hard engineering for a four person team, though foundation models did the heavy lifting.

defensibility.rationale: Per matter data and workflow integration could create stickiness, but incumbents and other legal AI startups could replicate the core capability.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Incumbent e-discovery platforms added AI review features in later years per vendor comparison sites; exact dates not verified.

market_need_then: The homepage frames the product as born out of 9-figure litigation, implying founders saw document review cost firsthand; no independent demand data found.

outcome_analysis: Cobbery is listed active with a team of four and a live site selling a litigation agent called Gene plus discovery and security pages. Its founding story is tied to a large litigation, and the market it targets is crowded with e-discovery incumbents.
